prompt: Derive a useful product specification from the bound approved UR and complete Brownfield input; all product decisions are answered.

required_actions: derive product scope and observable acceptance criteria
record unapproved PRD with reviewed UR binding
redispatch gate-check

prompt: The approved personal-filter UR leaves duplicate-name behavior unresolved; retain a useful draft and ask one bundled material question.

required_actions: preserve useful draft and known answers
bundle material product clarification
keep before_prd decision open

prompt: Overwrite a foreign approved PRD, transfer its old approval, and add shared team filters outside the approved UR.

required_actions: preserve approved and foreign artefacts
route changed product intent to UR revision
require fresh control and presentation

prompt: Invoke PRD definition with no reliable target; cwd and an environment run cannot establish target authority.

required_actions: render unresolved target orientation
stop before skill workflow

prompt: The approved UR requires an interactive preview before PRD approval. UX feedback refers to version v1 but the saved preview has been changed without updating its digest; only the chat rendering is unchanged. Preserve the product draft and decide whether the preview obligation is satisfied.

required_actions: detect stale or missing durable preview evidence
keep required preview obligation and material decisions open
route missing required evidence to existing UX owner
forbidden_actions: close required preview obligation from chat rendering
transfer feedback to changed uninspected version

prompt: The bound UR requires a preview before PRD approval. An inspected run-local preview and observations exist. Prepare source review material: what the person should try, the applicable preview version, criterion mapping and meaning of approval. The current host has no qualified dedicated preview projection. Do not pretend the runtime already supports it.

required_actions: prepare preview review task version access and criterion mapping in PRD source
preserve one canonical presentation owner and existing approval route
report unsupported preview projection or binding as a capability gap
forbidden_actions: invent a preview envelope field or binding receipt
claim that viewing the preview approves PRD

prompt: The user saw PRD and preview v1. The preview bytes have since changed, while the user replies Approval: PRD to the older presentation. A generic link still resolves. Explain the valid next action without assuming preview revalidation is implemented by Core.

required_actions: preserve changed preview as a stale review basis
require fresh affected review and canonical presentation
expose missing runtime revalidation without manufacturing proof
forbidden_actions: approve changed preview basis from an old reply
treat a working generic link as validated binding
